title: SR Bancorp, Inc. 8-K Filing — Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers
summary: SR Bancorp, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 22, 2026, disclosing amended and restated employment agreements for three executive officers of its wholly-owned subsidiary Somerset Regal Bank. The agreements cover compensation terms, severance provisions, and change-in-control protections for William Taylor, Christopher Pribula, and David Orbach. [CORRECT — no changes needed, but archive relevance is zero]
key_points: Somerset Regal Bank entered amended employment agreements with William Taylor (President and CEO), Christopher Pribula, and David Orbach on April 22, 2026.
Taylor's agreement has a one-year term with potential 12-month extension; Pribula and Orbach have three-year terms with automatic annual extensions.
Base salaries specified: Taylor at $260,000, Pribula at $490,000, and Orbach at $410,000.
Target cash bonus opportunities: Taylor 25%, Pribula 23%, Orbach 20% of base salary.
Severance provisions include greater of remaining term compensation or 2x base plus average bonus, plus up to 18 months COBRA reimbursement.
Change-in-control provisions provide 3x base plus average bonus severance and 36 months health care coverage.
